reason: DataFusion: EXISTS as a value (not a filter) is not implemented in its physical plan

by design on DataFusion: a sum of floating-point values is added as DECIMALs (DataFusion computes a CTE at each read, in parallel, and two reads of a sum must be equal), so 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3, not Power BI's 0.30000000000000004
